sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Plans, wishes and arrangements

Три способа говорить о будущем:

  • Plan: I’m going to visit my grandparents.
  • Wish / idea: I’d like to learn to drive. · I want to travel. · I’m planning to change my job.
  • Arrangement (время и место уже известны): I’m meeting Anna at six.

Чтобы объяснить, зачем: because + причина.

I’m going to study tonight because I have a test tomorrow.

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
I’m going to + verb → plan

I’m going to cook dinner.

I’d like to / I want to / I’m planning to + verb → wish or idea

I’m planning to visit Paris.

I’m + verb-ing + time → arrangement

I’m meeting my friend at 6.

Remember:

I’m planning to go (not: planning go)
I’d like to visit (not: I’d like visit)

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
going to, will or Present Continuous?

Выбираем форму по ситуации, а не по правилу:

  • going to — plan or intention (decided before): I’m going to apply for a new job.
  • Present Continuous — arrangement (time and place are fixed): I’m seeing the doctor on Friday at 5.
  • will — decision at the moment, promise, opinion: I’ll help you with that. · I think it’ll be cold.

Главное: когда решение принято и насколько всё организовано?

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Decided before the moment of speaking?

→ yes, but no details yet: going to
→ yes, with time and place: Present Continuous

Deciding now, promising or giving an opinion?

→ will

Examples:

I’m going to start my own business. (intention)
I’m meeting my manager at 10. (arrangement)
“There’s no milk.” “I’ll get some.” (decision now)

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Intentions, predictions, arrangements and spontaneous decisions

  • Intention: I’m going to / I intend to / I’m aiming to finish my degree this year.
  • Arrangement: We’re launching the product on 1 March.
  • Prediction with evidence: Look at those clouds — it’s going to rain.
  • Prediction from opinion: I’m sure prices will go up. · She’ll probably accept.
  • Spontaneous decision: I’ll take the blue one.
  • Just about to happen: The train is about to leave.
  • In progress at a future time: This time next week I’ll be lying on a beach.

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Choose by purpose

intention → going to / intend to / aim to
arrangement → Present Continuous
evidence-based prediction → going to
opinion-based prediction → will + probably / definitely / I think
moment decision → will
very soon → be about to
action at a future moment → will be + -ing

Remember:

I think I’ll… / I probably won’t… (not: I don’t think I’ll…) → both are fine in speech, but “I probably won’t” is more natural.

  3. We have a meeting at 10 on Monday. → We’re…
  4. The film starts in a minute. → It’s about to…
  5. I’m sure she’ll say yes. → She’s bound to…

sections.title: Vocabulary Bank

Vocabulary:

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Nuance in future reference

Будущее — это не только will и going to. Важна степень уверенности и регистр:

  • Near-certainty: She’s bound to win. · It’s sure to cause problems. · In all likelihood, we’ll miss the deadline.
  • Possibility: They may well cancel. · We could end up moving abroad.
  • Scheduled / official: The CEO is due to speak at 9. · The company is set to launch in March. · The minister is to visit Paris.
  • On the verge: The team is on the point of signing the deal. · She’s about to resign.
  • Looking back from the future: By next June I’ll have finished. · This time next year I’ll be working in Berlin.

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
1. How certain are you?
virtually certain → bound to / sure to / certain to
probable → likely to / will probably
possible → may well / might / could

2. Is it official or scheduled?
→ due to / set to / is to + verb

3. Is it about to happen, or completed by a future time?
→ on the point of / about to · will have + V3 · will be + -ing

Remember: register matters — The firm is set to expand (news) vs We’re going to expand (casual).

  • Your own career in the foreseeable future.

  • Say what is firm, what is provisional, and what could go wrong.
  • Respond to a challenge: “What if it falls through?”

Try to use:

bound to → may well → due to / set to → will have + V3

About me
routine · background · strength · goal · daily life · family · free time · used to · proud of · dream

sections.title: Разминка
sections.html:
Tell about yourself

Расскажи о себе подробнее: жизнь, привычки, цели.

Questions:

  • What is your daily routine?
  • What are you proud of?
  • What is your biggest goal?
  • What did you use to do as a child?

Vocabulary:
routine · background · strength · goal · daily life · family · free time

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Talking about yourself

  • I usually get up at 7 and go to work by bus.
  • I'm proud of my family.
  • My goal is to speak English fluently.
  • I used to play the piano.
  • My dream is to travel around the world.

Vocabulary:
routine · background · strength · goal · daily life · family · free time · used to

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Present → Past → Future

Now: I work / live / study ... .

Past: I used to ... / I moved ... in 2019.

Future: I'm going to ... / My goal is ... .

sections.title: Задание 1
sections.html:
Choose the correct form

  1. I usually get up / getting up at 7.
  2. I used to / use to play the piano.
  3. I'm proud of / for my family.
  4. My goal is / are to speak English well.
  5. My dream is to / is travel around the world.

Vocabulary:
routine · proud of · goal · dream · used to

sections.title: Задание 2
sections.html:
Complete the sentences

  1. I usually ______ up at 7. (get)
  2. I used ______ play football. (to)
  3. I'm ______ of my work. (proud)
  4. My ______ is to learn English. (goal)
  5. My ______ is to live by the sea. (dream)

sections.title: Задание 3
sections.html:
Talk about you for one minute

Say something about:

  • your daily routine
  • your past
  • your goals

Use usually, used to, going to.

sections.title: Говорим
sections.html:
My life

Tell me:
In the morning I usually ______.
As a child I used to ______.
In the future I'm going to ______.

Then ask: What about you?

sections.title: Итог
sections.html:
Today I can talk about my life: past, present and future.

describe my routine
say what I used to do
talk about my goals

One last question:

What is your biggest dream?

A2.outcome: Today I can ask for help when I don't understand.

sections.title: Vocabulary Bank
sections.html:
Clarifying
repeat · slowly · mean · spell · explain · example · sorry · pardon · understand · again

sections.title: Разминка
sections.html:
I don't understand

Поговорим о том, что делать, если ты что-то не понял.

Questions:

  • What do you do when you don't understand a word?
  • Do you ask people to repeat?
  • What is difficult for you in English?
  • Do you use a dictionary?

Vocabulary:
repeat · slowly · mean · spell · explain · example · sorry

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
When you don't understand

  • Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
  • Could you speak more slowly?
  • What does ... mean?
  • How do you spell it?
  • Could you give me an example?
  • Do you mean ... ?

Vocabulary:
repeat · slowly · mean · spell · explain · example · sorry · pardon

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Say → Ask → Check

Sorry, I didn't catch that. / Could you repeat?

What does ... mean? / Could you explain?

Do you mean ... ? / Is that right?

sections.title: Задание 1
sections.html:
Choose the polite phrase

  1. Could you repeat that, please? / What?
  2. Could you speak more slowly? / Slowly!
  3. What does this word mean? / I don't know it.
  4. Do you mean tomorrow? / Tomorrow?

Vocabulary:
repeat · slowly · mean · spell · explain

sections.title: Задание 2
sections.html:
Complete the sentences

  1. Could you ______ that, please? (repeat)
  2. Could you speak more ______? (slowly)
  3. What does "deadline" ______? (mean)
  4. How do you ______ it? (spell)
  5. Do you ______ next week? (mean)

sections.title: Задание 3
sections.html:
Role play: a phone call

Your partner gives you an address and a time, quickly. You do not understand. Use clarifying phrases.

  • Ask to repeat.
  • Ask to spell the street.
  • Check the time.

sections.title: Говорим
sections.html:
My strategies

Tell me:
When I don't understand, I ______.
A difficult word for me is ______.
I usually ask ______.

Then ask: What do you do?

sections.title: Итог
sections.html:
Today I can ask for help when I don't understand.

ask to repeat and slow down
ask what a word means
check that I understood

One last question:

What is the hardest thing to understand in English?

A2.outcome: Today I can order food and ask for the bill.

sections.title: Vocabulary Bank
sections.html:
In a restaurant
menu · starter · main course · dessert · bill · order · allergic · vegetarian · tip · recommend

sections.title: Разминка
sections.html:
At the restaurant

Поговорим о том, как заказывать еду в ресторане.

Questions:

  • Do you often eat in restaurants?
  • What is your favourite dish?
  • Are you allergic to anything?
  • Do you leave a tip?

Vocabulary:
menu · starter · main course · dessert · bill · order · allergic

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Ordering food

  • Could we see the menu, please?
  • I'd like the soup for a starter.
  • What do you recommend?
  • I'm allergic to nuts.
  • Could we have the bill, please?
  • Is the tip included?

Vocabulary:
menu · starter · main course · dessert · bill · order · allergic · vegetarian

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Table → Order → Problem → Bill

A table for two, please. / Could we see the menu?

I'd like ... . / What do you recommend?

Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered. / The bill, please.

sections.title: Задание 1
sections.html:
Choose the best phrase

  1. I'd like the soup. / Give me soup.
  2. Could we have the bill? / Money!
  3. I'm allergic to nuts. / I hate nuts.
  4. What do you recommend? / What is it?

Vocabulary:
menu · starter · dessert · allergic · recommend

sections.title: Задание 2
sections.html:
Complete the dialogue

  1. Could we see the ______, please? (menu)
  2. I'd ______ the chicken, please. (like)
  3. What do you ______? (recommend)
  4. I'm ______ to nuts. (allergic)
  5. Could we have the ______? (bill)

sections.title: Задание 3
sections.html:
Role play: restaurant

You are at a restaurant with a friend. One of you is vegetarian. Order a starter, a main course and a dessert.

  • Ask for recommendations.
  • Order.
  • Ask for the bill.

sections.title: Говорим
sections.html:
My food

Tell me:
In a restaurant I usually order ______.
My favourite dish is ______.
I don't like ______ because ______.

Then ask: What do you recommend?

sections.title: Итог
sections.html:
Today I can order food and ask for the bill.

order a starter, main course and dessert
ask for a recommendation
mention an allergy

One last question:

What is the best restaurant you know?

A2.outcome: Today I can start a conversation with someone new.

sections.title: Vocabulary Bank
sections.html:
New people
introduce · where are you from · how long · job · live · visit · interesting · really · me too · in common

sections.title: Разминка
sections.html:
New people

Поговорим о том, как познакомиться и найти общие темы.

Questions:

  • Do you like meeting new people?
  • What do you talk about with strangers?
  • Do you have friends from other countries?
  • What do you have in common with your friends?

Vocabulary:
introduce · where are you from · how long · job · live · visit · interesting

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Starting a conversation

  • Hi, I'm Max. I don't think we've met.
  • Are you here on holiday or for work?
  • How long are you staying?
  • Really? That's interesting!
  • Me too! We have a lot in common.

Vocabulary:
introduce · where are you from · how long · job · live · visit · interesting · really

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Introduce → Ask → React → Share

Hi, I'm ... . / Where are you from?

Really? / That's interesting! / Me too!

I'm from ... . We have ... in common.

sections.title: Задание 1
sections.html:
Choose the best reaction

  1. A: I love hiking. B: Me too! / I don't know.
  2. A: I'm from Italy. B: Really? That's interesting! / OK.
  3. A: I work in IT. B: What do you do exactly? / Bye.
  4. A: I'm here on holiday. B: How long are you staying? / Why?

Vocabulary:
introduce · in common · interesting · really · visit

sections.title: Задание 2
sections.html:
Complete the conversation

  1. Hi, I'm Max. I don't think we've ______. (met)
  2. Where are you ______? (from)
  3. How ______ are you staying? (long)
  4. Really? That's ______! (interesting)
  5. Me ______! I love music too. (too)

sections.title: Задание 3
sections.html:
Role play: a conference

You meet a new person at a conference. Start a conversation and find 2 things you have in common.

  • Introduce yourself.
  • Ask 3 questions.
  • Find what you have in common.

sections.title: Говорим
sections.html:
New people in my life

Tell me:
The last person I met was ______.
We talked about ______.
We have ______ in common.

Then ask: Who did you meet recently?

sections.title: Итог
sections.html:
Today I can start a conversation with someone new.

introduce myself
ask and react to answers
find things in common

One last question:

Who was the last interesting person you met?

A2.outcome: Today I can talk about my hobbies in detail.

sections.title: Vocabulary Bank
sections.html:
Hobbies
hobby · interested in · keen on · collect · take up · join a club · how often · for years · relax · skill

sections.title: Разминка
sections.html:
My hobbies

Поговорим о хобби: что ты делаешь, как часто и почему.

Questions:

  • What are your hobbies?
  • How often do you do it?
  • When did you take it up?
  • Would you like to try a new hobby?

Vocabulary:
hobby · interested in · keen on · collect · take up · join a club · how often

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Talking about hobbies

  • I'm keen on photography.
  • I take photos every weekend.
  • I took up running two years ago.
  • I've been collecting stamps for years.
  • It helps me relax.
  • I'd like to join a club.

Vocabulary:
hobby · interested in · keen on · collect · take up · join a club · how often · for years

sections.title: Схема
sections.html:
Hobby → How often → How long → Why

I'm interested in / keen on ... .

I ... every week. / I took it up ... ago.

I like it because it helps me ... .

sections.title: Задание 1
sections.html:
Choose the correct form

  1. I'm keen on / in photography.
  2. I took up / take up running two years ago.
  3. I've been collecting stamps for / since years.
  4. I do yoga every / each morning.
  5. It helps me relax / to relaxing.

Vocabulary:
hobby · keen on · take up · collect · relax

sections.title: Задание 2
sections.html:
Complete the sentences

  1. I'm ______ on cooking. (keen)
  2. I ______ up yoga last year. (took)
  3. I've been painting ______ three years. (for)
  4. How ______ do you play tennis? (often)
  5. It helps me ______. (relax)

sections.title: Задание 3
sections.html:
Interview about hobbies

Ask your partner:

  • What's your hobby?
  • How often do you do it?
  • How long have you done it?
  • Why do you like it?

Then swap roles.

sections.title: Говорим
sections.html:
My hobby

Tell me:
My hobby is ______.
I took it up ______ ago.
I like it because ______.

Then ask: Would you like to try it?

sections.title: Итог
sections.html:
Today I can talk about my hobbies in detail.

say how often and how long
explain why I like it
ask about someone's hobby

One last question:

What new hobby would you like to try?
